payload.claim: Change the view to constructive if (a) two consecutive quarters show organic revenue growth of 20%+ in local currency EXCLUDING the DKK 15.1m IFRS reallocation, i.e. genuine XcytoMatic XM30 placement volume rather than reclassification, (b) the Roche Diagnostics collaboration is disclosed as converting into a specified number of instrument placements or a committed consumables stream, and (c) FY2026/27 guidance is set at 20%+ revenue growth off the 505–525m base with EBITDA margin held above 54%. Change it negatively if guidance is cut again, if organic growth reverts to flat/negative for two quarters, if gross margin slips below 90% (evidence the automated platform is being priced against competition rather than sold on differentiation), or if the disclosure file escalates from administrative reprimands to a restatement or a formal accounting directive touching reported revenue.

prediction.reasoning: Raised guidance of DKK 505–525m implies roughly 12–16% growth for the current year, of which about 3pp is the non-recurring DKK 15.1m IFRS reallocation, leaving underlying growth near 10%; with CGT customer funding cycles and slow pharma validation cited in the bear case, the following year should land below 15% — well short of the 25.5% compounding the price is paying for.
